audits.claim: The PR removes the duplicate-group-key log and its test while changing detector results to dictionaries.
audits.evidence: The supplied diff deletes test_state_results_multi_group_dupe and the old duplicate-key logging branch; the parent versions are tests/sentry/workflow_engine/processors/test_detector.py:117-133 and src/sentry/workflow_engine/processors/detector.py:58-75. At the head, DetectorHandler.evaluate declares a dictionary result at src/sentry/workflow_engine/processors/detector.py:125-129, and StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate iterates unique group_values.items() and assigns one result per key at :235-244. process_detectors consumes dictionary values at :58-62, so the old duplicate-key-list input no longer fits the contract, and the replacement multi-group test asserts the dictionary at tests/sentry/workflow_engine/processors/test_detector.py:175-205. The historical log removal is true, but no failing supported input is identified and restoring an obsolete test is unnecessary.
